newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ENGLAND COACHING GETS $65 MILLION BOOST.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ENGLAND COACHING GETS $65 MILLION BOOST.

text.p: English soccer coaching is to get a 40 million pounds ($65 million) boost from the premier league and the country's national lottery.
The premier league will provide 20 million pounds over the next four years for Centres of Excellence to coach England's up-and-coming football talent.
The English Sports Council has agreed in principle to provide a matching 20 million pounds from the Sports Lottery Fund.
"Forty million pounds of new money for our talented youngsters is a wonderful commitment to continuing excellence in our national game," sports minister Tony Banks said on Thursday.
